newsitem.title: USA: Louisiana has $318 million surplus for FY 1996.
newsitem.headline: Louisiana has $318 million surplus for FY 1996.

text.p: Louisiana ended fiscal 1996 with a $318 million surplus, which will be used to retire debt, Commissioner of Administration Mark Drennen said.
The fiscal year ended June 30 but auditors only finished the final report earlier this week.
Drennen said $191 million of the surplus was due to revenue collections that exceeded projections because of the improving economy. The rest was due to state agency spending below authorized levels.
The surplus was Louisiana's seventh in the last eight years. The money will be used to pay off bond debt early, though state officials still must decide which issues to retire.
